{"brief": {"objective": "学生能列举至少三种学习率调度策略并说明各自适用场景", "keyClaim": "学习率衰减满足 Robbins-Monro 条件（∑η_t=∞, ∑η_t²<∞），保证 SGD 收敛", "misconception": "认为学习率应该全程固定", "visualTask": "三条学习率曲线随时间变化：Step Decay、Cosine、Warmup + Cosine", "evidencePolicy": "derived"}, "headline": "学习率调度：从固定到自适应", "lead": "实际训练中常使用学习率衰减策略，如 Step Decay、Cosine Annealing、Warmup。", "blocks": [{"type": "chart", "chartType": "line", "categories": ["0", "20", "40", "60", "80", "100"], "series": [{"name": "Step Decay", "values": [0.1, 0.1, 0.1, 0.01, 0.01, 0.01]}, {"name": "Cosine Annealing", "values": [0.1, 0.095, 0.081, 0.059, 0.031, 0.0]}, {"name": "Warmup + Cosine", "values": [0.0, 0.05, 0.1, 0.081, 0.059, 0.031]}], "xLabel": "训练步数", "yLabel": "学习率", "caption": "三种常见学习率调度策略的曲线对比（示意数据）", "annotations": [{"kind": "point", "x": "30", "y": 0.01, "label": "Step Decay 在 30 步骤降", "tone": "accent"}, {"kind": "point", "x": "10", "y": 0.05, "label": "Warmup 线性上升", "tone": "accent"}], "id": "b11"}, {"type": "formula", "latex": "\\sum_{t=1}^{\\infty} \\eta_t = \\infty, \\quad \\sum_{t=1}^{\\infty} \\eta_t^2 < \\infty", "caption": "Robbins-Monro 条件：学习率序列需满足总和发散、平方和收敛，保证 SGD 几乎必然收敛到局部极小值。", "id": "b12"}]}
